invariants.rationale: It is reasonable to assume the TMX file argument is non-null since it is required for loading the map.
ImageResolver is necessary to resolve tile images, so it is expected to be non-null when entering the method.
This expression is always true and covers the fact that parameter may be null or non-null. (Will not appear as actual invariant, just showing example of form.)
It is likely expected that the FileHandle provided actually references an existing file, or an exception will be thrown otherwise.
The TMX file should not be a directory, as it is expected to be a file containing the map data.
